about: Workshop recipe cards for the recipe box. Every visitor sees these. Newest entries go at the end; the page shows the newest first.

recipes.title: The brilliant new employee brief
ingredients: What a good result looks like
recipes.method: I'm planning [what it is] for [who it's for]. It matters because [why]. Please make [the thing], about [length], in [format]. A great result would [what success looks like]. Include [anything extra you want], and ask me questions first if something is unclear.
recipes.notes: Anthropic suggests treating Claude like a brilliant new employee who doesn't know your house rules yet. If a friend with no background would be confused by your prompt, Claude will be too.

recipes.title: Show it a few examples
ingredients: Three samples of the style you like
The new thing you want written
recipes.method:
Here are examples of the style I like:
<example>[first sample]</example>
<example>[second sample]</example>
<example>[third sample]</example>
Now write [the new thing] in the same style.
recipes.notes: Examples are one of the most reliable ways to steer tone and format. Anthropic recommends 3 to 5, and making them different from each other so Claude copies the style, not one quirk.

recipes.title: Make a skill just by chatting
ingredients: A job you do the same way again and again
One or two good examples or a template
A few minutes to answer Claude's questions
recipes.method: I want to create a skill for [the job, like planning our weekly family dinners]. Here's how I do it now: [your steps]. Here's an example of a result I liked: [example]. Ask me whatever you need to know about my process, then build the skill.
recipes.notes: Claude will ask when you'd use the skill and what makes a result good. Answer with enough detail that someone capable but new could follow your approach. Save the skill file, then test it on a real task.

source.title: How to create a skill with Claude through conversation (Claude Academy)

recipes.title: Give Claude a job title
ingredients: The role you want Claude to play
recipes.method: You are a [role, like a patient piano teacher] who specializes in [focus, like adult beginners]. [Your question or task.]
recipes.notes: Anthropic says setting a role focuses Claude's behavior and tone, and even a single sentence makes a difference. Their own example is a helpful coding assistant specializing in Python.

recipes.title: Order up a ready-made spreadsheet
ingredients: What you want to keep track of
The columns or categories you need
Any totals or calculations you want done for you
recipes.method: Create an Excel spreadsheet to track [what, like our monthly family expenses]. Include columns for [your columns]. Add automatic calculations for [totals you want], and a simple chart on a second sheet.
recipes.notes: Claude can make real Excel, Word, PowerPoint and PDF files you download from the chat. The setting is called Code execution and file creation (or Create and edit files) under Settings, Capabilities. Making files uses more of your plan's usage than a normal chat.

source.title: Create and edit files with Claude (Claude Help Center)
